## Rules

- CI installs with the lockfile, frozen (`{{PM}} install --frozen-lockfile` or equivalent).
- Secrets come from the platform's secret store — never from files in the repo, never echoed in logs.
- Reproduce a CI failure locally with the same command before changing the pipeline.
- Changes to production deploy config are proposed to the user, not applied silently.

## Report

What failed (log excerpt), why, the change made, and how it was verified.
